contract: Both addresses are the +0x0A movement-stream field of fixed records in the common actor table. The shared template initializer writes the ROM root, scene/resource setup may publish a replacement root, and scene reset paths clear the field.
limitations: These names identify the actor-record field and do not assign a higher-level actor behavior to each pointed-to stream.
conclusion: Fixed slot-one and slot-two movement-pointer references now have canonical identities without changing the shared actor-table model.
